chose: PostHog AI observability should move to @posthog/ai/otel + @ai-sdk/otel, not hand-rolled $ai_generation capture
over: keeping the manual posthog-node capture in queues/recipe-enrichment/lib/capture.ts
because: withTracing has NO otel runtime deps (dist/vercel imports only uuid + @posthog/core), so capture.ts's stated reason for hand-rolling is wrong. BUT it throws '[PostHog AI] withTracing supports Vercel AI SDK v5 and v6 models only' for specificationVersion outside v2/v3, and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible@3 under ai@7 reports v4 (verified at runtime). So the OTel span-processor path is the only PostHog-supported native path for this stack, and PostHog's own docs say exactly that.
